content: csv-parse's stream/Transform API (not the sync/callback API) is the scalable choice for 100k+ row imports -- pipe read-stream -> csv-parse(columns/mapHeaders options) -> validation transform -> batch-write, keeping memory bounded. mapHeaders lets column-mapping be applied during parse (return a mapped header name or null to drop a column). This stream -> map -> validate -> enqueue pipeline is the standard shape for a preview+dry-run then commit CSV import flow.
